title: Puharich meditates in airports, the Nine speak through his watch

tellings.quote: Puharich would stop at airports and try and meditate because he thought he would be bringing about world peace and that the Nine would speak to him through his watch

plain: A scientist named Puharich, who Michels's episode title describes as having worked with the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, is said to have stopped at airports in the 1970s to meditate, believing it would help bring about world peace. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, and says Puharich believed that the Nine, a council of beings he thought he was in contact with, would speak to him through his watch.
